lore.upgrade_aquatic.chiseled_driftwood_: A shelf that holds up to six Books, which can be placed and taken out individually.
lore.upgrade_aquatic.disc_fragment_atlan: A fragment of a Music Disc. Nine of them make the disc 'Atlantis'.
lore.upgrade_aquatic.music_disc_atlantis: A music disc that can be played in a Jukebox. hatsondogs - Atlantis.
lore.upgrade_aquatic.nautilus_bucket: A bucket holding a live Nautilus. Empty it into water to release it.
entity.upgrade_aquatic.thrasher.descript: A hostile sea monster that lurks in cold, deep oceans. It senses vibrations and stuns its prey with a sonic blast. Drops its teeth.
entity.upgrade_aquatic.great_thrasher.de: A larger, deadlier Thrasher found in frozen deep oceans. Drops its teeth.
entity.upgrade_aquatic.nautilus.descript: A passive mob found in warm oceans. It can be caught in a bucket, and sometimes drops its shell.
